thread:
Maya (CS): heads up — several accounts in this week's onboarding cohort saw activation failures (503) between 09:12–09:26 UTC. I'm starting outreach.
Liam (Onboarding): thanks Maya. can you share which accounts? I have sessions scheduled this afternoon.
Maya (CS): affected list: AcmeRetail, NimbusHealth, and BrightForms. small cohorts, but onboarding flows blocked at first inference call.
Priya (Support): I pulled logs, getting `503 Service Unavailable` from embeddings service + `batch timeout` in gateway. attaching snippet: `ERROR gateway: request timeout after 15000ms`
Josh (Eng): investigating now. initial theory: autoscale misfired on a dedicated pool causing queue buildup. seeing a spike in queue depth at 09:11.
IncidentBot: Deploy 2026-03-19T09:05 by @infra-team — rollout completed to dedicated-pools-v2.
Josh (Eng): rollback to prior pool variant in progress (manual). estimate 12–18m to bring queues down. will post when stable.
Maya (CS): can we get a short status we can send customers? need something by 09:40 UTC for scheduled check-ins.
Josh (Eng): draft: "We're aware of transient 503 errors impacting activations. Engineers observed autoscale lag on a dedicated pool and are rolling back the recent pool change. Estimated mitigation: ~15 minutes. We'll follow with an RCA."
Priya (Support): I can send that to the three accounts now and offer priority follow-up. tagging @Liam for rebook if needed.
Liam (Onboarding): please include me on replies. I'll pause any live demos until I get confirmation the flow is clear.
Maya (CS): outreach sent to AcmeRetail & NimbusHealth; BrightForms opted to wait for confirmation first. I used this note and offered a short credit for time lost.
Josh (Eng): rollback completed at 09:28. queue depth returning to normal, 503s dropping. still monitoring for 30m. will collect logs for RCA.
IncidentBot: Incident created #INC-2026-0319-07 with severity = SEV3.
Maya (CS): thanks. action items: 1) Eng to post RCA in ~24h, include timeline and mitigation; 2) CS to send follow-up post-mitigation note + credit details; 3) Onboarding to reschedule any affected sessions.
Priya (Support): I'll attach relevant log excerpts to the incident and include suggested customer-facing blurb.
Josh (Eng): adding root cause hypothesis: autoscaler throttle combined with a small surge from onboarding verifications. will validate with traces.
Maya (CS): good. once RCA draft ready ping me and I'll approve customer copy. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Liam (Onboarding): ack, standing by.
Maya (CS): marking as resolved for customer comms at 09:42 UTC after confirmation from Josh.
Josh (Eng): monitoring complete at 09:57, no recurrence. closing incident ticket pending RCA update.
